purpose: CP104 targeted TL3 diagnostic closure: equal-Space frontier responses to dual legacy mains, Kinetic/Missile movement-order decomposition, TL3 Energy synergy decomposition, and power-pressure hot-spot fixes. Diagnostic-only; no population inference and no automatic technology change. CP104 is the final planned TL3-focused diagnostic checkpoint before higher-TL chart expansion unless an architectural defect is found.

fixedShell.description: CP102 v7 enumerates STL/FTL/PDS and Hull capacity explicitly; no combat-system Installation Space remains hidden in the fixed shell.
